decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting line fits the firm's specialist robust-lighting niche and has stayed on the website steadily, which suggests satisfactory results, and a large firm has the slack to carry long-cycle defence business.

The general interior luminaire went from its own launch page to a plain mention, which is a normal shift into the standard catalogue rather than a sign of shortfall, and it serves the firm's core office and education markets.
The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship and was promoted again in 2024 as a latest release, so results appear to meet aspirations and it matches the firm's strategic direction.

The marine searchlight survived the pruning of the sibling HMI searchlight, likely as the modern replacement, and it keeps a stable website presence, so there is little reason to search for alternatives, though some risk remains in this narrow segment.
